criterion: Dead ends / One way per task
description: There is no UI to remove a member. J. Doe's profile shows Identity, Devices and Live sessions with only a Close button. Removal requires `client show --project ID`, reading JSON to find the humanId, and `client revoke --kind member`.
expected: A creator-only "Remove from project" action on the member's profile (with confirmation).
actual: CLI-only; 2 terminal commands plus JSON reading.
suggested_fix: Add the action to ProfileDialog for the creator, calling the existing revoke route.

description: Flag 21 confirmed: `client revoke --kind member --id <J. Doe actor ID>` returns NOT_FOUND "Admission not found" with no hint that the identity (humanId) is needed. The failed attempt also consumes the operation ID: retrying with the correct humanId and the same --operation-id returns OPERATION_ID_REUSED "Operation ID belongs to different input".
expected: Accept the actor ID, or say "Use the person's identity ID (humanId from client show)"; failed validation should not reserve the operation ID.
suggested_fix: Resolve actor IDs to humanId in revoke, improve the message.

description: The creator revoking her own membership gets FORBIDDEN "Only creator may revoke other memberships", which tells the creator she is not the creator.

After revocation, the removed person's board says "Project access revoked; local data remains saved / This invitation or membership was revoked. Ask for a new invitation." with Retry and Open another project. Following the advice fails: a new Human invitation is refused with IDENTITY_MISMATCH "Existing human identity requires My device proof", and for a revoked device (STORY-045) a new My device invitation is refused with REVOKED "Project membership is not available". Retry can never succeed. Recovery actually needs a fresh client directory, which is never said. The revoked project also disappears from `client list`.
expected: Revocation is described as permanent for this identity/device, Retry is hidden, and the real recovery path (if any) is stated.
actual: Advice and Retry lead to dead ends.
suggested_fix: Use a REVOKED-specific hint that does not suggest a new invitation; drop Retry for definitive revocation.

description: Revoked Actors look like ordinary offline members: J. Doe stays in Priya's avatar stack and People list as "Human · Offline", a revoked agent (Cursor, STORY-045) as "Agent · Offline", the invite row stays "Used", and `client show` has no revoked flag.
expected: Revoked members are marked (or moved to a "Removed" group) everywhere they appear.
actual: No visible difference between revoked and offline.
suggested_fix: Expose revocation in the actor directory and render a Removed badge.
